issue.title: DB2: Missing resource bundle
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

In some cases, when an exception is thrown, the error message is not localized due to a missing resource bundle. The error message reads `Missing resource bundle: A resource bundle could not be found in the com.ibm.db2.jcc package for IBM Data Server Driver for JDBC and SQLJ ...`. The DB2 `ERRORCODE` and `SQLSTATE` are correct.

### Expected behavior

A helpful error message is shown.

### Actual behavior

Error message says `Missing resource bundle: A resource bundle could not be found in the com.ibm.db2.jcc package for IBM Data Server Driver for JDBC and SQLJ ...`

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer:

1. clone https://github.com/turing85/quarkus-db2-resource-bundle:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/turing85/quarkus-db2-resource-bundle.git && \
  quarkus-db2-resource-bundle
```
2. Start the db2 container, wait for it to be started:
```bash
docker compose \
  --file local-deployment/docker-compose.yml \
  up --detach
```
3. Take a look at the [`application.properties`  (`github.com`)](https://github.com/turing85/quarkus-db2-resource-bundle/blob/main/src/main/resources/application.properties), notice that the datasource is misconfigured: the `username` is missing
4. Run the application in dev mode
```bash
./mvnw clean quarkus:dev
``` 
5. Notice that the application throws the following exception:

### Additional information

- Adding all resources in `com.imb.db2.jcc:jcc`, package `com.ibm.db2.jcc.resources` does not help
- The error seems to occur in `com.ibm.db2.jcc.am.b5.a(b5.java:810)`, but since the driver is not open-source, we cannot further analyze the issue
- This issue is most probably related to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/36399
